links.outcome: LLM performance compared against urologists on the same reconstructed clinical cases
links.effect: Human urologists significantly outperformed both AI models in diagnostic test appropriateness (P < 0.01); DeepSeek-R1 comparable to humans and ChatGPT-5 Pro on logical coherence (P > 0.05).
links.quote: Notably, human urologists significantly outperformed both AI models in diagnostic test appropriateness (P < 0.01), primarily because DeepSeek-R1 struggled with "test avoidance," tending to recommend redundant investigations (P < 0.0001).

links.outcome: Reproducibility of accuracy across three independent runs
links.effect: All models achieved >92% accuracy; ChatGPT-5 Pro 97.52% and DeepSeek-R1 95.04%, both displaying superior stability.
links.quote: ChatGPT-5 Pro ranked first (97.52%), followed closely by DeepSeek-R1 (95.04%), with both displaying superior stability.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the medical knowledge and clinical reasoning capabilities of several LLMs (DeepSeek and ChatGPT variants) against human urologists using exam questions and simulated clinical cases, without testing a specific deployment practice or operational safeguard.
